name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task has two requirements, and the candidate covers only part of the first. (1) 'Carry the box to the exit' needs the box in the agent's hands when the exit is reached. The single clause Existence(at_exit) only requires reaching the exit and lets the agent arrive with empty hands, which would still finish the task. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) so holding_box must hold whenever at_exit holds. (2) The rule 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' is missing entirely: no clause responds to box_fell, so an agent that ignores a fallen box loses nothing. Add a hard Response(box_fell, holding_box) so every box_fell must be followed by holding_box again. Keep the hard Existence(at_exit).
